body:
Tested on my machine, and it looks great overall! I also skimmed through the code and nothing stuck out to me there, but you're much more experienced/knowledgeable with this stuff than I am so that checks out 😅

There were two things I felt a little bit iffy about, regarding the squiggle shape itself:

- It's pretty hard to make out, but I think I can see the seam between the instances of the squiggle icon, such that it feels a little bit less like a continuous line. Maybe there'd be a way to overlap them a tiny bit so that there's no seam (if one does currently actually exist)?
- The squiggle itself feels like maybe it's the tiniest bit too tall, in my opinion? On the other hand, the purpose of these squiggles is to draw the user's attention, and in an "ideal" script there would be no squiggles (because there'd be no warnings or errors).

These might be things to discuss if there are other reviews we're waiting on, but I also definitely don't want to bikeshed over one or two pixels and delay the PR, haha.
